description: Client-side script for 'Employee Advance' form in ERPNext, handling form setup, validation, and actions like creating payment entries, expense claims, and return entries.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the Employee Advance form, configuring fetches and queries.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, adding buttons based on document status and amounts.

methods.name: make_deduction_via_additional_salary
methods.description: Creates a deduction via additional salary process.

methods.name: make_payment_entry
methods.description: Creates a payment entry, possibly via bank entry if specified.

methods.name: make_expense_claim
methods.description: Creates an expense claim for the employee advance.

methods.name: make_return_entry
methods.description: Creates a return entry to refund or settle the advance.

methods.name: employee
methods.description: Triggers fetching employee currency and pending amount when employee is selected.

methods.name: get_pending_amount
methods.description: Fetches the pending amount for the employee.

methods.name: get_employee_currency
methods.description: Fetches the currency for the employee.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Handles currency change, setting exchange rate if needed.

methods.name: set_exchange_rate
methods.description: Fetches and sets the exchange rate between employee currency and company currency.
